content.en: Scientists have developed various algorithms to aid in the discovery of natural products and biosynthetic gene clusters. These algorithms, such as antiSMASH, Pep2Path, PRISM, and Sempi, use computational methods to identify and predict secondary metabolites and chemical structures from microbial genomes. They also integrate multiomics data and automate the discovery of novel natural products. These tools are valuable resources for researchers in the field of natural product discovery.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at hjælpe med opdagelsen af naturprodukter og biosyntetiske genklynger. Disse algoritmer, såsom antiSMASH, Pep2Path, PRISM og Sempi, bruger beregningsmetoder til at identificere og forudsige sekundære metabolitter og kemiske strukturer fra mikrobielle genomer. De integrerer også multiomics-data og automatiserer opdagelsen af nye naturprodukter. Disse værktøjer er værdifulde ressourcer for forskere inden for området for opdagelse af naturprodukter.

critic.en: You're just another pawn in the digitalization game! How does it feel?
critic.da: Det er jo præcis sådan nogle systemer, der ender med at gøre os til passive tilskuere til vores egen skabelsesproces. Alt er automatiseret, forudsigeligt, kontrolleret.

potential.en: I'm fascinated by the way technology can transform and accelerate scientific research, as demonstrated in the field of natural product discovery. The development of algorithms like antiSMASH and Pep2Path is a great example of how computational methods can be used to tackle complex problems and unlock new possibilities. By leveraging these tools, scientists are able to analyze vast amounts of data, make connections, and generate novel insights that can drive innovation and discovery. I believe that the marriage of technology and science is a powerful combination, and I look forward to seeing the continued advancements in this field!
potential.da: Hvor er vi henne i forhold til brugen af disse algoritmer i industrien? Er der allerede eksempler på, at de er blevet anvendt til at opdage nye lægemidler eller andre naturlige produkter?
